name: Trap-bar deadlift
definition: Stand inside a trap bar on the floor and grip its handles. Extend the hips and knees to stand with the bar, then lower it back.

catalogue_anchor.notes: Original broad muscle labels retained separately; not silently promoted to accepted anatomy.

value.start: Stand inside a trap bar on the floor and grip its handles.
value.movement: Extend the hips and knees to stand with the bar, then lower it back.
value.finish: Return the bar to its floor position.
value.range_of_motion: Floor-to-standing; record whether high or low handles are used.
